diagnosis.suspected_cause: The payment container has exited (state exited, unhealthy, restart count 0). Checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls fail with a DNS lookup error for "payment". Frontend then returns 500 on /api/checkout, so orders don't complete.
alternatives: Checkout's own fault: unlikely, since its errors originate in the Charge call to payment and its resources look normal.
A Docker DNS or network problem: unlikely, since payment is confirmed exited and other services resolve fine.
Kafka or opensearch memory pressure: no link to the checkout errors seen.
diagnosis.uncertainty: I did not find why payment exited (crash, OOM or manual stop), and I did not read its logs. Checkout had no WARN+ logs, so the failure evidence comes mainly from traces. Kafka memory is 88% and opensearch is 92%, both with no restarts. Jaeger memory grew 66% but sits at only about 13.5% of its limit. None of the three show errors, restarts or stopped reporting. I judge them unrelated background pressure, but opensearch and kafka could become a separate risk. Their request and error metrics are empty, so I could not check them beyond resources. The tools show live data, not the exact historical incident window.
diagnosis.next_step: Check payment's exit code and last logs with docker inspect or docker logs, for example to see whether it was OOM-killed or crashed. Then restart it and confirm checkout charges succeed. Separately, watch opensearch and kafka memory.

proposals.reason: The payment container is in state exited and unhealthy, with restart count 0. It stopped reporting metrics about 200s before the check. Checkout's Charge calls to payment fail, which is why frontend returns 500 on /api/checkout. A restart is the catalog action that addresses a crashed or stopped process. I don't know why payment exited, so the restart may not hold if the cause is persistent, such as OOM or a bad config.
proposals.risk: The root cause of the exit is unknown, so payment may exit again. Restart is not reversible. Docker's restart will not fix a bad config or a dependency fault. Payment is already down, so the impact on in-flight requests is minimal. | catalog: In-flight requests to the service fail while it restarts (typically 5-20s). Does not fix bad code, configuration, dependencies or network faults.
proposals.expected_effect: The payment container starts and resumes reporting metrics. Checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls resolve and succeed. The checkout and frontend error rates drop back to baseline and orders complete.
proposals.rollback: No rollback is available for a restart. If payment exits again, escalate to a human and inspect its exit code and logs.
